use_cases.title: Open a savings account online
use_cases.description: A prospective customer opens a savings account on the web without visiting a branch by moving through a four-step wizard that starts at Account type, proceeds through About you, Fund it, and Review, keeps step status visible, allows back-navigation from step two onward, and blocks progress from the identity step until required personal and contact details are complete and correctly formed; in this demo scope the flow ends at “Open account” without real KYC, credit checks, money movement, or session persistence between visits.
use_cases.summary: Open a savings account through the web wizard.
use_cases.value: Acquires savings-account applications without a branch visit while screening out obviously invalid applicant data before downstream verification.

use_cases.title: Calculate a federal income tax estimate
use_cases.description: A prospective customer uses the Federal Income Tax Calculator to estimate either a federal refund or an amount owed, with results recalculated live as inputs change and no submit action or page reload; the calculator presents an ordered estimate breakdown, applies filing-status-based standard deductions, floors taxable income at zero, reveals an itemized-deductions input when Itemized is chosen, and displays amounts as whole-dollar US currency.
use_cases.summary: Estimate a federal refund or amount owed live.
use_cases.value: Helps visitors estimate tax outcome and decide how much they may want to deposit.
